appointmentDetail.linkBody: The session opens ten minutes before the start. You can already check your camera and microphone and note what you want to talk about.
appointmentDetail.prep: Before the session: think about what you'd like to start with. You don't need to repeat what you shared in the intake chat.
appointmentDetail.changeUntil: Changes allowed until 24 hours before · until {deadline}
appointmentDetail.changeClosed: The change deadline has passed ({deadline}). Changes are allowed until 24 hours before.
appointmentDetail.cancelBody: We'll cancel your appointment on {date} with {name}. You can book a new one whenever you like.
appointmentDetail.cancelled: Your appointment is cancelled. You can book a new one whenever you like.
appointmentDetail.afterSession: After the session: rating and next step

therapistCancelled.titleFemale: We're sorry, {name} had to cancel your session
therapistCancelled.titleMale: We're sorry, {name} had to cancel your session
therapistCancelled.reason: Something unexpected came up. There's nothing you need to do.
therapistCancelled.rebookSameFemale: Wait for {name} · choose a new time
therapistCancelled.rebookSameMale: Wait for {name} · choose a new time
therapistCancelled.priorityFemale: Your new time has priority in her schedule and keeps the same session number.
therapistCancelled.priorityMale: Your new time has priority in his schedule and keeps the same session number.
therapistCancelled.rebookHelp: If no time suits you, the care team will contact you within 48 hours to help you rebook.
therapistCancelled.talkNow: I need to talk to someone now
therapistCancelled.notCounted: This won't count against your sessions.

missed.title: You missed your session on {date}
missed.reassure: It happens, and it's okay. Nothing is deducted and it doesn't count against you.
missed.okReply: Good to hear. Choose a new time whenever it suits you.
missed.tiredReply: Thanks for telling us. Take your time; your therapist is here when you're ready.
missed.notOkBody: Thank you for telling us. You don't have to wait for a session: someone can talk with you now.
missed.talkNow: I need to talk to someone now
missed.sendError: Your answer didn't reach us. Try again.
